I read the whole target file and its imported `Defs.lean`. I also grepped for `Halfspace` in the NandakumarRamanaRao sources. The target defines only `sepNormal` and `sepOffset`, which are problem-specific data for power cells: the normal is `2 • (sⱼ - sᵢ)` and the offset is `‖sⱼ‖² - ‖sᵢ‖² - wⱼ + wᵢ`. I did not search Mathlib for a matching concept. I don't expect one, since `powerDist` and `cell` are also defined locally in `Defs.lean`. The target's two theorems restate the cell as a half-space intersection, so they are not independent versions of a Mathlib concept.

`NRR.Halfspace.of` is defined in `HalfSpace.lean`, not in the target. That file's line 36 states `Halfspace.of u c = Geometry.lowerClosedHalfspace u c := rfl`, which suggests a possible competing half-space definition there. The target file only uses it, so that is outside this file and I did not report it. I found no justified finding in the target.
